title: Outdoor living area behind the street setback area
text: Outdoor Living Area (applies to R2-R40 only). C1.1.1 An outdoor living area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1a. (Refer to Figure 1.1a) Table 1.1a Outdoor living area provisions. Location: R2-R15, R17.5, R20-R25, R30-R35, R40 Behind the street setback area(3). 3 Does not apply where C1.1.2 is met. C1.1.2 Notwithstanding C1.1.1, a single consolidated outdoor living area may be located within the primary street setback area where any street walls or fences within the primary street setback area are visually permeable in accordance with C3.6.5 and C3.6.6.

exceptions.label: C1.1.2 single consolidated OLA in the primary street setback area with visually permeable street walls and fences

replaces.note: C1.1(ii) behind the street setback; front-setback OLA now a deemed exempt option

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

verified.note: Coding corrected to R2-R40: the location cell is merged across all rows including R2-R15.

notes: Table 1.1a location column with note 3 'does not apply where C1.1.2 is met'. On the page the location cell 'Behind the street setback area(3)' is merged across all five rows, R2-R15 included (the R2-R15 'No minimum applicable' cell spans only the area, roof cover and dimension columns), so coding is R2-R40 (corrected from R17.5-R40 in the page-image pass). building.front_fence.visually_permeable is a proposed fact (C3.6.5 and C3.6.6 compliance stated by the applicant) to avoid duplicating Part 3 fence thresholds here.
